card.name: Health website header and footer text
card.fires_on: Words in web-page header and footer text on health sites, such as 'information' after 'health and medical', 'content' on a site, or 'and' in a slogan. It fires on the word just before the noun a site promo phrase is about.

modes.label: Health newsletter promos
modes.description: Nouns or linking words inside 'health and lifestyle news' or 'medical information delivered to your inbox' ads.
modes.example: Get the latest health and medical<< information>> delivered direct to your inbox FREE!

modes.label: Site content and licence notes
modes.description: The word 'content' at the start of a website notice or warning.
modes.example: Unless otherwise noted,<< content>> on this website is licensed under a Creative

modes.label: Slogans and bios
modes.description: Linking words or commas in tagline lists and author bios.
modes.example: Your daily resource for losing weight<< and>> staying fit.

card.plain: It marks promotional and footer wording on health websites, not clinical content.
